title: The Woman Who Was Already Cremated — Episode 1

characters.persona: Returned mother whose identity has been officially buried
Police sub-inspector assigned to verify Meera’s identity
Meera’s father who identified the burned body
Village records clerk who notices that Meera’s death paperwork was never properl

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Tara! Mohan! Please, call my children. Tell them their mother has come back.
lines.sfx_cue: police station gate clangs, crowd murmuring
lines.spoken: Tara! Mohan! Please… call my children. Tell them their mother has come back.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Stop there. Do not cross the desk until I ask you.
lines.spoken: Stop there. Do not cross the desk until I ask you.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Then ask quickly. I have waited... I have waited long enough.
lines.spoken: Then ask quickly. I have waited… I have waited long enough.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Your name.
lines.spoken: Your name.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Meera. Devraj's daughter. Tara and Mohan's mother.
lines.spoken: Meera. Devraj's daughter. Tara and Mohan's mother.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: She says she is the dead woman.
lines.spoken: She says she is the dead woman.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Call her father. Let him see her face.
lines.spoken: Call her father. Let him see her face.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: He will know me. Bring him here. Please.
lines.spoken: He will know me. Bring him here… please.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Constable, shut the gate. Nobody leaves, and nobody touches her.
lines.spoken: Constable, shut the gate. Nobody leaves, and nobody touches her.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Move aside. I will settle this.
lines.spoken: Move aside. I will settle this.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Baba...
lines.spoken: Baba…

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Do not call me that.
lines.spoken: Do not call me that.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Look at me. Properly. The cut above my eyebrow, I got it on your grain scale. You carried me home.
lines.spoken: Look at me. Properly. The cut above my eyebrow — I got it on your grain scale. You carried me home.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Many people have scars.
lines.spoken: Many people have scars.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Your left knee hurts before you sit. You hide money inside the red account book. Baba, please... just hold my hand.
lines.spoken: Your left knee hurts before you sit. You hide money inside the red account book. Baba, please… just hold my hand.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Do not touch me.
lines.spoken: Do not touch me.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: One touch. You will know.
lines.spoken: One touch… you will know.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I buried my daughter. I placed wood on her pyre with these hands. You are an impostor.
lines.spoken: I buried my daughter. I placed wood on her pyre with these hands. You are an impostor.

lines.speaker: VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Her own father will not touch her.
lines.spoken: Her own father will not touch her.

lines.speaker: SECOND VOICE IN CROWD
lines.text: Someone trained her. Why else would she come here?
lines.spoken: Someone trained her. Why else would she come here?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I came for my children. Where are Tara and Mohan?
lines.spoken: I came for my children. Where are Tara and Mohan?

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: My grandchildren have already suffered. They will not be displayed before a stranger.
lines.spoken: My grandchildren have already suffered. They will not be displayed before a stranger.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: They are not your shield. Bring them.
lines.spoken: They are not your shield. Bring them.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Sub-inspector, remove this woman before Tara hears this filth in the market.
lines.spoken: Sub-inspector, remove this woman before Tara hears this filth in the market.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: No. She entered a police station and made an identity claim. We record it before anyone removes anyone.
lines.spoken: No. She entered a police station and made an identity claim. We record it before anyone removes anyone.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: The police recorded her death. Is your own record now a rumour?
lines.spoken: The police recorded her death. Is your own record now a rumour?

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: One fact at a time. Meera, when did you last see your children?
lines.spoken: One fact at a time. Meera, when did you last see your children?

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: The morning I disappeared. Tara would not drink her milk. Mohan had fever... no, the fever began the night before.
lines.spoken: The morning I disappeared. Tara would not drink her milk. Mohan had fever… no, the fever began the night before.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: All of that was discussed after the funeral. Anyone in Dharmapur could repeat it.
lines.spoken: All of that was discussed after the funeral. Anyone in Dharmapur could repeat it.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Not this. Mohan called fever medicine bitter rain. Tara drew a moustache on the bottle so he would laugh.
lines.spoken: Not this. Mohan called fever medicine bitter rain. Tara drew a moustache on the bottle… so he would laugh.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: Enough.
lines.spoken: Enough.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: You know that happened.
lines.spoken: You know that happened.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: I know grief makes foolish people generous with information.
lines.spoken: I know grief makes foolish people generous with information.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Babulal, bring the death entry and the original identification file.
lines.spoken: Babulal, bring the death entry and the original identification file.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Madam, that file is sealed with the murder case.
lines.spoken: Madam… that file is sealed with the murder case.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Then open the cupboard, not the seal.
lines.spoken: Then open the cupboard, not the seal.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: If the woman is genuine, every connected page will have to be reviewed.
lines.spoken: If the woman is genuine, every connected page will have to be reviewed.

lines.speaker: devraj
lines.text: If. Please remember that word.
lines.spoken: If. Please remember that word.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: Show me what you wrote about me.
lines.spoken: Show me what you wrote about me.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: There is a death certificate, cremation acknowledgement, family identification and a station register entry.
lines.spoken: There is a death certificate, cremation acknowledgement, family identification, and a station register entry.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: And my children were made to live under those pages.
lines.spoken: And my children were made to live under those pages.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: Give me the date and status.
lines.spoken: Give me the date and status.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: Fourteenth November, two thousand twenty-two. Meera, daughter of Devraj, recorded deceased.
lines.spoken: Fourteenth November, two thousand twenty-two. Meera, daughter of Devraj, recorded deceased.

lines.speaker: meera
lines.text: I am standing in front of you.
lines.spoken: I am standing in front of you.

lines.speaker: babulal
lines.text: The station register still lists Meera as dead.
lines.spoken: The station register still lists Meera as dead.

lines.speaker: kavita
lines.text: And four men are in jail for murdering her.
lines.spoken: And four men are in jail for murdering her.
